issues.description: Docstring count inconsistency: first line says 'Return per-gate failure flags for the 10 pool-admission gates' but the detailed list at line 250 says 'The 11 gates mirror'. The actual count is 11 gates (train_trade_floor, train_return_floor, train_pf_floor, val_required, val_ret_positive, val_trade_floor, val_return_floor, val_pf_floor, train_val_gap, f4_concentration, overfit_ratio). Fix the first line to say '11 pool-admission gates' for consistency.
